prompt: I have a scanned PDF form (form.pdf) with non-fillable fields. I need to fill it with specific data. First, extract the form structure to identify all text labels, lines, and checkboxes with their exact PDF coordinates. Save the structure to form_structure.json. Then, analyze the structure and create a fields.json file that maps each form field to its entry location. Finally, fill the form by adding text annotations at the correct positions and output the result as filled_form.pdf. The form has fields for: Last Name (text), First Name (text), Age (text), US Citizen (checkbox), and Employment Status (choice between Employed/Unemployed/Student). Make sure all text is placed accurately within the entry areas and checkboxes are marked with an 'X'.
